name: Founder decision: Rule how the founders are trained as interviewers before the learning platform exists
text_content:
P39, founder-gated. The record requires trained interviewers (WP p.18) and puts the training on a platform that cannot exist before the team does (WP p.19). Pre-opening the founders are the only interviewers. Readiness rows 44 and 61 fail until both founders hold a training record, so the first lead's first interview cannot run. S6 wrote the training content and the interim record; the founders rule on how the interim record is issued and by whom. Carries the language gap with it: finding 18.4, readiness row 74, a first interview requested in a language neither founder holds has no trained runner and the record names no interpreter and no interim. Reads S5 I21's refusal of a hand-written training record as applying only once the stack can write one, which is an extension of a Session 5 position and needs ratifying alongside it. Urgent: it blocks the first hire.

Filed by Session 6 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhnt. Reasoning lives on the S6 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
